title: Active to Passive Voice: Practice — Quiz 115
content:
## Active to Passive Voice: Practice

Change statements and an instruction into the passive voice.

### Lesson focus

1. Praise the beautiful flowers.
2. We repair mobiles here.
3. English is spoken all over the world.
4. The rising sun is worshipped (by people).
5. Beds have to be kept aside (by hospitals) for VIPs, PM and President.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
